versions.subject: add sysmon_netcat_execution.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    # can not use OriginalFileName as is empty
    Image|endswith:
        - '\ncat.exe'
condition: selection

versions.subject: feat: some often used ncat command line strings
versions.detection:
selection:
    # can not use OriginalFileName as is empty
    Image|endswith:
        - '\ncat.exe'
selection_cmdline:
    # Typical command lines
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -lvp '
        - ' -l --proxy-type http '
        - ' --exec cmd.exe '
        - ' -vnl --exec '
condition: selection or selection_cmdline
versions.spl: Image="*\\ncat.exe" OR CommandLine IN ("* -lvp *", "* -l --proxy-type http *", "* --exec cmd.exe *", "* -vnl --exec *")
